name: TabPanel
purpose: Scrolling content of the active Settings section.

values.when: surface-2 token: the settings-general pane. Overflow-y auto, px-8 py-7.

keyboard: Scrolls with keys when focused. Proposed: tabIndex 0 on the scroll region when it overflows.
platform: Desktop Settings window. Web: open (Settings as a route).
open: Conflict: settings-general uses the surface-2 token; settings-shortcuts, settings-capture and settings-about record a literal oklch(0.995 0.001 255). Both designs keep one token; the literal is not a variant until someone confirms it is intended. B's ScrollArea raised tone for this pane is the same token.
